The results panel

In one line: the results panel shows the matches of Form A as cards beside the chat. It changes only when the form changes.

What it is

  • The results panel is the right half of /chat on a desktop. It has a header, the "Best Matches" sort and a grid of person and place cards (interface-shape.md).
  • The header tells what the panel shows. It narrows from "Everything in Mumbai" to "Rooms in Powai–Vikhroli under ₹25,000 · 8 results".
  • A label sits on the photo of a card. "Best match" means that the card meets three or more preferences of the person. "Didn't say: smoking" means that the card did not answer a dealbreaker (PD3a).
  • With no match, the panel shows "No relevant results" and the suggested posts (PD6c).
  • On a phone, the chat fills the screen. A results card in the chat opens the panel with "Show all", and the input stays at the bottom (PD6a).

How it fits our project

Part Where
The rules: the header, the form key, the labels and the update rule apps/web/lib/results.ts, with unit tests
The panel apps/web/components/results/results-panel.tsx
The results card in the chat apps/web/components/results/results-card.tsx
The split view apps/web/components/chat/chat-screen.tsx
The sample data of the preview apps/web/lib/sample-results.ts
  • The panel is a pure function of the form. formKey() keeps the values and the weights of Form A, not the sources. Thus, a confirmed default gives the same key and no new results.
  • The order never moves under the person. While the person scrolls, new results wait. They show 1.5 seconds after the last scroll. panelUpdate() holds this rule.
  • A card opens in place. A place opens its detail in the panel, with "Ask in chat". A person opens on the person page. A guest gets the sign-in wall (PD6b).
  • The preview. The assistant (T-12) does not fill Form A yet, and the match query (T-14) does not exist. To see the panel, open /chat?preview=results or /chat?preview=empty. A "Sample data" badge shows on the panel. T-14 removes the preview.

The choice we made

  • The panel shows when intent, area and budget have a value: interface-shape.md, hole 3.
  • The update rule, the empty state and the header states: PD6c.
  • The preview with sample data: the spec of T-15.

Gotchas

  • The area names come from the API. While they load, a slug reads as words: powai-vikhroli reads "Powai Vikhroli". areaName() does this.
  • The areas route is public. api() takes no user for a public route, so the chat of a guest can name the areas.
  • Headless Chrome is at least 500 px wide. To check the phone layout, set the size through the DevTools protocol (Emulation.setDeviceMetricsOverride), not with --window-size.

Tickets

  • T-15: the results panel, the labels, the empty state, the split view and the preview.
